# Spinner

An indicator that can be used to show a loading state.

Exports from `uiofcraft` and `uiofcraft/spinner`: `Spinner`.

## Usage

```tsx
import { Spinner } from "uiofcraft"
```

```tsx
<Spinner />
```

## API Reference

### Spinner

Use the `Spinner` component to display a loading indicator.

| Prop        | Type     | Default |
| ----------- | -------- | ------- |
| `className` | `string` |         |
